description:
Music video directed by Asami Kiyokawa for the song Moshimo Inochi ga Egaketara by YOASOBI.

Note: There exists two versions of this video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on December 12, 2021 and an English version of the song titled "If I Could Draw Life" also by YOASOBI, which was uploaded on November 18, 2022.
